general.title: Major Hedge Funds Mostly Lose in ‘Nowhere to Hide’ October
general.summary: Many of the world’s biggest hedge funds extended their losses last month, as a sell off in technology stocks, a government bond meltdown and Brazil’s shock election combined to deliver widespread volatility and one of the broadest declines since the coronavirus pandemic.

general.title: Poland’s Tusk Ends Central Bank Standoff Over Board Nominees
general.summary: Poland’s prime minister signed off on appointments to the central bank’s management board, effectively ending a months-long standoff that threatened to cripple the institution’s day-to-day operations.

general.title: Palantir Is Concerned About Europe's Slow AI Adoption
general.summary: Louis Mosley, who oversees Palantir's business in the UK and Europe, says, “blue chips on this side of the Atlantic are not yet adopting AI." He made the comments in a conversation with Tom Giles at Bloomberg Tech in London. "That worries me because we’re starting to see extraordinary results from those customers, those big American blue chips,” he adds. (Source: Bloomberg)
